bands.selection: positional_spectrum.select_power_matched_controls on the BASE table, with the period-3 band and its representable harmonic protected. The same bands are used on every arm so the intervention is identical across arms; per-arm power ratios are recorded in `carrier_fourier`.

held_identical_across_arms: masking draws (keyed by seed, window index, epoch)

mlm_recipe.source: Chen et al. 2024, reimplemented -- upstream ships architecture only

design.only_intended_difference: the paired indel's offset (0 for L0; residue mod 3 for L1 vs L2)
design.operator: length-preserving paired indel: delete `offset` bases deep in the UPSTREAM intron, insert a tandem duplication of `offset` exonic bases at donor_pos - exon_offset. donor_pos, next_acceptor_pos, the donor->acceptor span and the window length are byte-preserved and IDENTICAL across all three arms.
design.operator_limit: the final 30 exonic bases before the donor, and the whole downstream exon, keep their native register; only the bulk of the upstream exon is shifted as a block

health_probes.acceptor_g_top1_rate: masked top-1 at the 3' AG's G, with the donor unmasked
health_probes.donor_g_top1_rate: fraction of cells whose masked donor G is the top-1 base
health_probes.mlm_health_masked_top1: CouplingTask.mlm_health -- MASKED top-1 at non-site positions. NOT CouplingScorer.mlm_health, which does not mask and cannot fail.

evaluation.readout: CouplingTask.margin at the masked donor; corruption AG->AC at the acceptor
evaluation.shared_draws: one draw sequence is used for EVERY arm and EVERY dose, so all contrasts and the difference of differences are paired rather than independently resampled

leakage_control.residual_risk: the k-mer screen detects NEAR-identity only; distant paralogs diverged past about one substitution per k bases are not flagged

omega3.reason: Omega3 asks whether an IMPOSED carrier relocation moves behaviour. This run asks whether TRAINING moved the learned Fourier phase, and whether the trained contrast depends on the carrier. They are different questions and one may not stand in for the other; no Omega3 capability preflight was run here, so no Omega3 number is reported.

persistence.note: Binaries are never committed to this repository. Every reported statistic is rederivable from the per-cell arrays and position tables persisted here, without re-running the model; the sha256 of each file is recorded above.

pilot_reference.comparability: NOT COMPARABLE AS A GATE. This run uses k=10 (the pilot used k=1) and adds an unedited L0 arm, so the eligible-window set, the corpus bytes and the edit sizes all differ. The pilot values are printed for orientation only.

primary_endpoint.clustering: donor_gene, shared draws across every arm and condition (paired)
primary_endpoint.name: DoD(band, dose) = [Psi_X - Psi_Y]_intact - [Psi_X - Psi_Y]_band-attenuated
primary_endpoint.why: A per-arm dose ladder asks whether a checkpoint's Psi needs the carrier. Only the difference of differences asks whether the TRAINING CONTRAST needs it, and only its comparison against power-matched control bands makes that carrier-specific.

question: Does the annotated-phase preference produced by phase-structured continued pretraining depend on the learned period-3 positional carrier?

scope_caveats.L0_is_not_edit_matched: L0 carries no indel, so L1-minus-L0 conflates 'phase-preserving edit' with 'any edit'. L1 vs L2 is the edit-matched contrast; L0 is the generic-continuation control. Neither substitutes for the other.
scope_caveats.band_power_wording: A scalar period-3 band power licenses only 'aggregate period-3 band power was similar'. It sums squared moduli, so it is blind to a phase rotation, and it sums across bins and hidden dimensions, so it is blind to redistribution. See `carrier_fourier`, which reports all three.
scope_caveats.cross_checkpoint: The trained arms are no longer the instrument the base reading was calibrated on; their overall coupling means move substantially under training, so signed coupling retention ratios against a near-zero or negative baseline are not retentions. Every ratio is reported beside its raw baseline and a `signed_retention_interpretable` flag.
scope_caveats.edit_size: k=10: the arms differ by 1-2 bases of edit SIZE (offset 30 against 31/32) as well as by residue mod 3. This REDUCES the size confound relative to the k=1 pilot; it does NOT REMOVE it.
scope_caveats.non_detection: An arm contrast whose interval includes zero but also includes effects above the 0.05 SESOI is UNRESOLVED, not equivalent. Read `sesoi_verdict` on each contrast; this artifact never writes 'left it at baseline'.
scope_caveats.seeds: 2 training seeds, one lineage triple each. Observed in 2 exploratory lineage triples -- NOT demonstrated. The replicate for a corpus intervention is the TRAINING SEED; every bootstrap interval here covers EVALUATION-PARENT resampling and nothing else, and the across-seed numbers are a RANGE over a handful of draws, never an interval.
